summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new client pages (AI Studio + The Voice Room) and the admin CMS media tabs + Aperçu preview flow with YouTube video. All acceptance criteria pass: nav links (desktop + mobile), page structure/testids/counts, FR→EN translations, mobile 390 no overflow, admin new tabs render, preview-mode video tile shows muted iframe + play overlay, click opens full-screen video-player with YouTube embed, close works, hero watch button appears when cover.video is set. No console errors. No saved admin changes (used Aperçu simulation via localStorage preview key; draft cleared after test).

lang_toggle.en_ai_lead: We turn bold ideas into extraordinary visual experiences.

critical_code_review_comments: VideoTile uses standard <button disabled>; when disabled, the tile correctly shows no play overlay. Good. Consider aria-label on the tile button for accessibility when enabled (currently relies on inner title text).

PageHero.toPreview autoplays a muted YouTube iframe for the cover — on iOS Safari this can be blocked occasionally; the LoopMedia already provides the poster image as fallback, so visual continuity is fine. No change required.
ContentEditor auto-syncs the draft to localStorage every 300ms including when nothing was edited (overwrites existing op-preview-draft). Harmless, but could race with a second admin tab. Minor.
withNewPages in i18n.js correctly injects AI Studio and Voice Room links into saved menus before 'contact' — verified both links appear in nav after merging default content.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Preview-only localStorage draft (op-preview-draft) was injected with YouTube URL for aiStudioMedia.cover.video and aiStudioMedia.works.0.video to validate preview rendering, then cleared. No admin save was performed, so no Versions restore needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Studio and Voice Room pages, nav wiring (desktop + mobile), FR/EN lang toggle, mobile responsive, admin new CMS media tabs, and preview-mode YouTube video flow (muted preview iframe + full-screen player with sound, close + hero watch button) all verified at 1440 and 390 viewports with 0 console errors. The admin preview behavior was validated via the documented localStorage mechanism (PREVIEW_KEY='op-preview-draft', /ai-studio?preview=1) rather than clicking Aperçu (same effect, keeps popup out of Playwright). No saved content changes.
